projects.name: TransitOps Montreal
projects.caption: Turning transit telemetry into a clearer picture of route health.
projects.description: Transit operators need a clear view of service issues. I’m building a dashboard to identify active vehicles, stale updates, route gaps, and bus bunching risk from public GTFS data and live or simulated vehicle snapshots.
details: Building the full-stack dashboard with Go, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to analyze STM bus route health.
Implementing ingestion and metrics logic for vehicle activity, update freshness, route gaps, and bunching risk.
Designing an LLM operations analyst that recommends service actions from route telemetry through an agentic loop. This feature is still in the design stage.

projects.name: GitToCampus
projects.caption: Helping students find their way across campus and into the classroom.
projects.description: Students need practical campus and classroom routing. As Technical Lead of an 11-member Agile team, I led a mobile navigation app from Figma mockups to working interfaces. Our professor awarded it first place in the cohort.
details: Led development using React Native, TypeScript, and Expo, translating Figma mockups into mobile UI.
Implemented classroom navigation using Dijkstra’s algorithm and processed GeoJSON coordinate data.
Integrated Google Maps and Google Calendar for campus routing and served as Technical Lead for the 11-member Agile team.

experience.summary: Developed fault management logic in Go for a 5G microservice containerized with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes, handling 6 raise/clear alarm events across 3 fault conditions and publishing fault telemetry to Kafka.
experience.result: 10+ components migrated from C++ to Go · 99% code coverage
details: Refactored and migrated 10+ service components from C++ to Go, implementing custom JSON serialization, bitmask-based policy evaluation, and TAI group lookup logic while achieving 99% code coverage in SonarCloud.
Assumed Scrum Master responsibilities after a team reorganization, leading daily stand-ups and sprint planning while removing blockers for teammates.

experience.summary: Built scalable ETL pipelines using Python and SQL across Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, and SQL Server to migrate millions of production shipment records for maritime logistics operations.

details: Migrated 10,000+ XREF records and 10+ Power BI datasets into Databricks, standardizing data sources and reducing Azure DevOps workflow runtime by 60 minutes per run.
